The conveyer system is only to be used during package processing and inspection done in Normal Gravity. Initiating the conveyer system in Zero G can result in damaged packages and floating debris. Zero G should only be used when package processing and inspection is completed, and after receiving express approval from a supervisor. items.source_en:
Technically speaking there is nothing wrong with this particular model. Working as intended I reckon. Unlike the last version it can and will hoist a missile into position. Never mind the sparks, all part of the process. And I do appreciate how the suspension coil doesn't completely throw off the alignment. Yeah burning up 5 aggregate circulating devices was definitely painful, so I'm glad we've gotten over that hill. But see that's where the compliments end. 

The bearing surface for the torsion spring in component 6C seems to be composed of a robust plastic material. It really holds everything in place quite well. Until it gets mildly warm. See now that's a problem when you put this thing together like this such that its adjacent to both Air Preheaters and the Fluid Agitator (that thing gives off so much fucking heat, what the hell are y'all thinking). 

Look you guys have provided us with some remarkable tech but poor physical integrity of these components results in compromised behavior leading to noticeable and frequent inconsistencies of proper cycling of states. So in other words, the damn thing barely works. Please, we've gone back and forth testing this 6 times now. Test your product, or we will find a new supplier!
items.legacy_ko:
기술적으로 말해서 이 모델 자체에는 아무런 문제가 없습니다. 제 생각에는 의도한 대로 작동합니다. 이전 버전과 달리 미사일을 제자리에 들어 올릴 수 있으며 실제로 그렇게 작동합니다. 스파크는 신경 쓰지 마세요. 모두 공정의 일부입니다. 그리고 서스펜션 코일이 정렬을 완전히 벗어나지 않는다는 점이 마음에 듭니다. 집계 순환 장치 5개를 태워 먹은 건 정말 뼈아픈 일이었지만, 그래도 그 고비를 넘겨서 정말 다행입니다. 하지만 칭찬은 여기까지입니다.

6C 구성 요소의 비틀림 스프링 베어링 표면이 강력한 플라스틱 소재로 만들어진 것 같습니다. 모든 것을 제자리에 잘 고정해 줍니다. 살짝 따뜻해지기 전까지는 말이죠. 이걸 공기 예열기와 유체 교반기 둘 다에 인접하도록 조립하면 문제가 됩니다(도대체 무슨 생각으로 이렇게 만든 겁니까? 유체 교반기에서 열이 너무 많이 발생합니다).

보세요. 여러분이 제공해 주신 기술은 정말 훌륭하지만, 이러한 구성 요소의 형편없는 물리적 무결성으로 인해 성능이 저하되어 정상적인 사이클링 상태가 눈에 띄게 그리고 빈번하게 불규칙해집니다. 다시 말해, 제대로 작동하지 않습니다. 부탁드립니다. 지금까지 여섯 번이나 테스트를 반복했습니다. 제품을 제대로 테스트하세요. 그렇지 않으면 다른 공급업체를 찾겠습니다!

items.source_en:
It's tough being around her. I've lived so long, but my first and really only love was Ada. We were married in those early years. I think one of the generators was broken and she died of radiation poisoning. And then she was back, but didn't know me.

I see glimpses of my Ada all the time, her manner of speaking, a tilt of the head, and sudden laugh. But she's not the same person.

I do agree w/Genghis on one thing: this is a prison. We need to make it our home instead. I would've loved nothing better to grow old with Ada with grandchildren on my knees.
